e.title: OSM Actuarial Skills（精算 AI 技能集）
e.summary: Open Source Modelling 的精算 AI 技能合集（3★）：历史 EIOPA RFR 曲线查询等精算日常任务 skills
e.body:
insurance_skills（open-source-modelling，3★）是 OSM 收集的精算师 AI 技能（skills）集：涵盖精算日常任务——历史 EIOPA 无风险利率（RFR）曲线查询（任意国家/期限/参考日、整条期限结构、隐含远期、贴现因子、Solvency II 压力曲线与参数 UFR/LLP/alpha/CRA/VA，含 2014-12 起全部月度发布数据）等。对 RIAA：精算 AI 技能三足之一（OSM/[[actuarial-skills]]（kalta-ai P&C）/[[insurance-skills]]（复旦））——学习精算师如何把领域任务（曲线查询/监管数据）封装为可复用 AI skills；EIOPA 曲线场景与 [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]、[[eiopar]] 配套。

## 同类工具
[[progressive-mcp-connector]]、[[state-auto-quotes-mcp]]、[[vault-health-mcp]]、[[enquiry-consent-mcp]]、[[eshm20-mcp]]

e.summary_hk: Open Source Modelling 的精算 AI 技能合集（3★）：歷史 EIOPA RFR 曲線查詢等精算日常任務 skills
e.body_en:
insurance_skills (open-source-modelling, 3★) is OSM's collection of AI skills for actuaries: everyday actuarial tasks — historical EIOPA risk-free-rate (RFR) curve queries (any country/tenor/reference date, whole term structures, implied forwards, discount factors, Solvency II stressed curves and curve parameters UFR/LLP/alpha/CRA/VA, carrying every monthly release since Dec 2014) and more. For RIAA: one of the actuarial AI-skill trio (OSM / [[actuarial-skills]] (kalta-ai P&C) / [[insurance-skills]] (Fudan)) — learn how actuaries package domain tasks (curve lookups/regulatory data) into reusable AI skills; the EIOPA-curve scenario pairs with [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] and [[eiopar]].

## Similar tools
[[progressive-mcp-connector]]、[[state-auto-quotes-mcp]]、[[vault-health-mcp]]、[[enquiry-consent-mcp]]、[[eshm20-mcp]]
e.body_hk:
insurance_skills（open-source-modelling，3★）是 OSM 收集的精算師 AI 技能（skills）集：涵蓋精算日常任務——歷史 EIOPA 無風險利率（RFR）曲線查詢（任意國家/期限/參考日、整條期限結構、隱含遠期、貼現因子、Solvency II 壓力曲線與參數 UFR/LLP/alpha/CRA/VA，含 2014-12 起全部月度發佈數據）等。對 RIAA：精算 AI 技能三足之一（OSM/[[actuarial-skills]]（kalta-ai P&C）/[[insurance-skills]]（復旦））——學習精算師如何把領域任務（曲線查詢/監管數據）封裝為可複用 AI skills；EIOPA 曲線場景與 [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]、[[eiopar]] 配套。

## 同類工具
[[progressive-mcp-connector]]、[[state-auto-quotes-mcp]]、[[vault-health-mcp]]、[[enquiry-consent-mcp]]、[[eshm20-mcp]]
